name: imvia-studio
description: Independent local IMVIA Studio MCP with one-click Lovart connection and explicit creation controls.

interface.shortDescription: Local workbench with one-click Lovart connection.
interface.longDescription: IMVIA Studio provides isolated local MCP, JSON state, task lifecycle, managed result import, loopback HTTP/SSE services, a secure no-terminal Lovart connection flow, and explicit creation/cost confirmation controls. The existing Lovart plugin remains independent.
capabilities: Explicit Lovart creation and cost confirmation
